Author: Serpens66
Name: Bugfixes and QoL
Description: Bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements for Stronghold Crusader Definitive Edition.

Changes: Replaced continuous startup resolution monitoring with an event-driven borderless focus guard that preserves settings.cfg while allowing explicit display-option changes.
Removed the non-Vanilla tooltips from the Surrender and Leave Mission buttons and restored Leave Mission to Vanilla's 300-pixel width whenever Surrender is unavailable.
Widened the shared Surrender and Leave Mission row, reduced the gap between both buttons, and restored the Vanilla leave-mission label and command through the registered binding host.
Added a default-enabled host option and confirmed in-game Surrender button that uses the natural lord-death, defeat, and statistics flow in singleplayer and tick-synchronized multiplayer.
Added a default-enabled host option that identifies a disconnected player during resynchronization and offers a confirmed, authoritative host kick.

Restricted the in-game Steam invitation prompt to a fully loaded frontend or active game, preventing it from appearing during loading screens, scene transitions, briefings, or an existing confirmation dialog.
Added a default-enabled local in-game prompt for incoming Steam lobby invitations, with direct acceptance through Vanilla's leave-and-join flow.
Added Vanilla's square portrait background behind the random custom-lord icon and separated it from the search box.
Added a Vanilla-styled question-mark button that adds a random custom lord from the currently visible list.
Moved the advanced random-skirmish lord-source filters slightly downward to match Vanilla's row spacing.
Added Vanilla, local, and Steam Workshop lord-source filters to both random-opponent dialogs in singleplayer and multiplayer skirmish lobbies.
Applied the mod's opaque, bordered, wrapping tooltip presentation to every custom-lord lobby tooltip.
Moved custom-lord sort headers outside Vanilla's ListView event route so header double-clicks can no longer add a lord.
Reused Vanilla's map-search placeholder for the custom-lord search box and removed its tooltip.
Prevented custom-lord column-header double-clicks from adding a lord and added Steam Workshop origin sorting.
Added a default-enabled host option with search and sortable Name and Lord Power columns for the custom-lord picker in singleplayer and multiplayer skirmish lobbies.
Added diagnosis to identify automatic game resolution reset and adjsut the fix for it later.
Added a default-enabled local startup display-resolution fix that reapplies the values loaded from settings.cfg during initialization and then fully stops monitoring.
Added optional Serps Mods Host dependency for Workshop mod-pack load ordering.
Added an optional, default-enabled Custom Trail starting-gold fix that ignores the unusable customisedExtremeTrail flag when reading .trail files and writes it as false when saving.
Updated shared lobby settings for Script Extender 1.42.0 by avoiding redundant UI-only persistence and using the official multiplayer-game signal.
Prevented early market-icon retries from constructing the game view model or interrupting mod-settings registration.
Fixed missing market-order editor icons by resolving game UI resources when the mod settings open, and hardened related UI resource access.
Added a per-player visual editor for an arbitrary detailed-market goods order, with preset persistence and the HD order as default.
Fixed local per-player preferences being repeatedly resolved through an unavailable network player ID and added the missing synchronized companion arrays.
Added separate, default-enabled settings for every previously always-active bug fix so each fix can be disabled independently.
Highlighted local and host activation controls, moved the host activation beside the Host options heading, and enlarged the shared tooltip presentation.
Separated the local client activation switch from the host-controlled fixes and reorganized the settings UI with readable wrapped tooltips.
Use validated reference RVAs on the audited DLL and reserve native signature scans for changed DLLs.
Moved confirmed apothecary-fix runtime messages to debug logging and removed temporary diagnostic overhead.
Added separate host settings for plague-cloud removal, stuck-apothecary, and apothecary target-reservation fixes.
Separated the three apothecary fixes into dedicated source files.
Prevented different apothecaries from selecting plague clouds covered by the same reserved area treatment.
Added deterministic cleanup for completed, abandoned, deleted, dead, and stalled apothecary reservations.
Fixed treated plague clouds occasionally returning to an active phase instead of fading.
Fixed apothecaries remaining in their building-exit waiting state after finding a plague target.
Fixed the authoritative popularity accumulator after natural plague-cloud expiry.
Added a host-controlled plague popularity fix: each active plague outbreak now applies exactly -1 popularity until all of its plague clouds are gone.
Added two automatically saved lobby-settings presets with migration of existing settings to preset 1.
Added the optional per-player HD Marketview product order for the detailed market trade panel.
Split the bug fixes and quality-of-life options from Some Settings into a dedicated mod.
Added an optional movement-cadence integration used by Extra Features without duplicating native hooks.
